subject: Download Data from DataTable After Using ColVis or ColReorder in Shiny

messages.author: b70049a975893f99
messages.subject: Download Data from DataTable After Using ColVis or ColReorder in Shiny
parts:
Hi,

I am using DataTable to display a dataset in my Shiny app, and have added the ColVis and ColReorder extensions to it. However, I am unclear as to how to use DownloadHandler to download the data from the table with only the visible, reordered columns. Below is example code from my shiny server.R, using mtcars as the table. I know how to use the filtered rows for selection, but cannot figure out how to access the ordered/visible columns (input$datatable_rows_all for the rows, but what about for the columns?). Could anyone help? I can't find any documentation for it online. Thanks!

output$datatable <- renderDataTable({
      
      datatable(mtcars, extensions = c('ColVis', 'ColReorder'), options = list(dom = 'RCT<"clear">lfrtip'))
      
      server = FALSE
      
    })


output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
      
      filename = function() {"mtcars.txt"},
      content = function(file) {

        filt_rows = input$datatable_rows_all
        
        write.table( ( as.data.frame( raw_file( ) [filt_rows, ] ) ), file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

      }
      
    )

parts: This is not currently supported, sorry. According to Yihui, neither DataTables nor ColVis provides an API to obtain the visibility status of all columns, at the moment.
